about.title: A Quick Look
about.card1.title: Who Am I
about.card1.body: I'm Rogério Edgar, a 20-year-old Designer & Multimedia Developer based in Portugal. I work right where creative vision meets code.
about.card2.title: What I Do
about.card2.body: Building immersive 3D WebGL scenes, digital platforms, and audiovisual stories. Focused on turning complex ideas into tactile digital experiences.
about.card3.title: Where I'm At
about.card3.body: Graduated in Design & Multimedia from the University of Coimbra, currently working as Senior Designer at jeKnowledge.
about.card4.title: Perspective / Status
about.card4.body: I design things people can click, play, and get lost in.
